source: house-style template A "They said I'd fail" (docs/house-style, after nateassets DcP_aC_AoQz); new characters and lines for fomo
note: Conflict line with a number at 0 s and the dare by 5 s (8 shots in 7 s), a cold low point held 2 s, the screens at the low point, the turn (with a ding) and the scale-up, a wordless six-beat montage at 0.4 s with day/night flips and a flash frame, a white flash into the time jump, a mirrored payoff under 8 words, a scream button, and the end line with Malik holding his phone up to the camera, the fomo logo clear, to close.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
End line (the default call to action every video ends on; it may be adapted to the story if it still names the brand and where to find it): Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image: keep its UI, logo and layout; the coin, numbers and chart are what the shot says:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>
<cast>
char:1 Malik, 17, red beanie, grey hoodie, headphones round his neck
char:2 Aunt Tasha, his aunt, neat bob, cardigan
</cast>
<places>
place:1 Tasha's kitchen
place:2 Malik's small bedroom
</places>
<video_model>Seedance 2.5: 4–30 s per clip, up to 30 reference images (prefer 8 or fewer)</video_model>
<script>
1| SCENE 1 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY
2| Aunt Tasha slams Malik's empty piggy bank on the counter.
3| TASHA: Your college fund is EMPTY?! Five hundred dollars!
4| MALIK: I put it in fomo.
5| TASHA: A phone app? That's your college money!
6| MALIK: Thirty days. Watch me.
7| TASHA: Thirty days. Then you're bagging groceries.
8| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
9| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
10| Malik drops his head onto his arms in the blue phone glow.
11| MALIK: Come on. One more.
12| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Malik's phone in his hand, a phone ding
13| Wordless montage, Malik in every shot: the grind first, then getting rich. Another late night with the energy cans, a red day he shakes off, a bigger win on his new desktop; then a delivery box of studio gear he rips open, Malik behind the mixing desk of his own studio, courtside at a packed game, front row at a sold-out arena show as confetti falls.
14| ★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on his monitor
15| SCENE 3 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
16| White flash. The red piggy bank sits on the counter.
17| Malik slides his phone across the counter.
18| TASHA: That's… real?
19| MALIK: Still want me bagging groceries?
20| Tasha grabs his phone with both hands and screams.
21| MALIK: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
22| ★ fomo screen: Home — Malik holds his phone up to the camera, the fomo logo clear
</script>

output.hook: Tasha bursts in and slams Malik's empty piggy bank down at 0 s, and the money ($500) is in her first line; his dare lands by second 5.

scenes.heading: INT. KITCHEN — DAY
scenes.look: Warm day interior: soft window key, warm bounce on faces, cool grey-blue walls; the red piggy bank is the one saturated object.

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: Your college fund is EMPTY?! Five hundred dollars!
shots.action: Tasha slams the empty piggy bank on the counter.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tasha, push in

shots.action: The piggy bank rocks on the counter, rattling empty.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on the piggy bank, crash zoom

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik holds up his phone.
shots.camera: Low-angle close-up on Malik, slow push in

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: A phone app? That's your college money!
shots.action: Tasha jabs a finger at the phone.
shots.reaction: Furious he gambled the college money: brows crash into a hard V.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tasha, whip pan from Malik

shots.action: Malik takes the hit.
shots.reaction: Stung, but sure he's right: his eyes flick down, then back up.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Malik's eyes, static

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik steps in, nose to nose with her.
shots.camera: Profile two-shot, nose to nose, slow orbit

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: Thirty days. Then you're bagging groceries.
shots.action: Tasha folds her arms.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tasha, snap zoom

shots.action: Malik hears the threat.
shots.reaction: Scared she might be right, too proud to show it: Malik swallows, jaw set.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Malik, static

scenes.heading: INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT, THEN MONTAGE: STUDIO, ARENA
scenes.look: Near black, cold blue phone light from below, until the win turns it green and warm; the grind stays at night in his room (blue light, energy cans, the clock); the payoff climbs into warm gold: the amber desk lights of his own studio, a bright courtside glow, gold confetti over a sold-out arena.

shots.action: Over Malik's shoulder: the token falls on the phone in his hand.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up on the phone in his hand, slow push in

shots.action: Malik drops his head onto his arms.
shots.reaction: Crushed, the bet looks lost: shoulders sag, eyes shut.
shots.camera: High-angle close-up, slow push in

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik lifts his head and taps the screen.
shots.camera: Close-up on Malik, static

shots.action: Malik's hand grips his phone as the token rockets up with a phone ding: the position reads +$420 (+38%).
shots.camera: Close-up on Malik's hand holding the phone, snap zoom in on the ding

shots.action: Another late night: at 3 a.m. Malik's thumb taps Buy on his phone, his face lit by its glow, energy cans stacking up, eyes red.
shots.camera: Medium shot, slow track along the desk

shots.action: A red day: Malik drops his phone on the bed, hands over his face, then picks it back up.
shots.camera: Close-up, quick tilt down to the phone and back up

shots.action: A bigger win: Malik at a new desktop setup, fist clenched as the monitor shows the fomo desktop trading screen, the balance reads $12,400.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up on the monitor, push in

shots.action: Malik rips open a delivery box of studio gear in his room, grinning.
shots.camera: Close-up, whip pan onto the box

shots.action: Malik spins round in the chair behind the mixing desk of his own studio and slams the faders up.
shots.camera: Medium shot, orbit round the chair

shots.action: Malik walks courtside at a packed game, the crowd on its feet behind him.
shots.camera: Wide, track in behind him

shots.action: Malik in the front row of a sold-out arena show, arms wide as gold confetti falls.
shots.camera: Wide, low angle, slow pull out

scenes.heading: INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
scenes.look: The same kitchen in golden-hour sun with a strong rim on both faces; warmer and richer than before.

shots.action: White flash onto the red piggy bank on the counter (the time card goes over it in post).
shots.camera: Close-up on the piggy bank, slow push in

shots.action: Malik's hand slides his phone across the counter and leaves it in front of Tasha; the fomo home screen's portfolio balance reads $512,400.
shots.camera: Overhead close-up on his hand and the phone, track with the phone

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.action: Tasha leans over the phone.
shots.reaction: Stunned it's real, the doubt draining away: her jaw drops, slowly.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tasha, push in

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik leans on the counter, calm.
shots.reaction: Quietly proud he proved her wrong: a small smirk.
shots.camera: Low-angle close-up on Malik, static

shots.action: Tasha grabs the phone with both hands and screams.
shots.reaction: Overjoyed for him, disbelief turning to a scream: mouth wide, eyes white all round.
shots.camera: Whip to an extreme close-up on Tasha's scream

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.line: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
shots.action: Malik takes his phone back and holds it up to the camera beside his grin, screen toward the lens; the fomo home screen's logo is sharp and its portfolio balance reads $512,400.
shots.camera: Medium close-up, Malik facing the camera, slow push in onto the phone

clips.seam: Hard cut to his bedroom that night.
White flash into one month later; the time card is added in post over the piggy bank.
